_comment: The baseline every character starts from, before any class is added. Classes contribute on top of this rather than replacing it, which is what makes a second and third class purely additive. Fields ending in Multiplier are BONUS FRACTIONS: 0 means no change, 0.25 means +25%.
_comment_attackSpeed: Seconds per swing. Classes never set this directly — they contribute attackSpeedMultiplier, so three classes combine into one sensible number instead of three intervals being added together.
_comment_explorer: The five stats particular to this game. Small non-zero baselines so a new character can see them working before any gear grants them.
_comment_moveSpeed: World units per second. 5.0 is what PlayerController hardcoded before this was a stat, so nothing changes on day one; classes adjust from here.
